questions.text: How did Kamila "meet" Apai Zarina?
opts: Through margin notes in library books
questions.correct: Through margin notes in library books
questions.hint: "She met her in the catalogue — in the handwritten notes that Zarina had left in the margins."

questions.text: According to the text about inspiring places, what do all four students' places have in common?
opts: They give something back without demanding from you
They're all in the city centre
questions.correct: They give something back without demanding from you
questions.hint: "They are places that give something back — energy, quiet, perspective."

questions.text: Amir's inspiring place is the WKU library.
questions.hint: Amir's place is the WKU server room, not the library.

questions.text: Zarina left notes in the ___ of library books.
questions.hint: "handwritten notes that Zarina had left in the margins of dozens of library books"

questions.text: What habit did Kamila start after discovering Zarina's notes?
opts: Writing response sentences in book margins
questions.correct: Writing response sentences in book margins
questions.hint: "Whenever she finishes a book, she writes one sentence in the margin. Not a summary. A reply."

questions.text: What is the final paragraph of the "inspiring places" text about?
opts: How a favourite place reveals something personal about a person
questions.correct: How a favourite place reveals something personal about a person
questions.hint: "If you want to understand a person, ask them about the place that makes them feel most themselves."

questions.text: What type of café does Daniyar describe?
opts: A small old-fashioned café in Aktobe that his grandmother used to take him to
questions.correct: A small old-fashioned café in Aktobe that his grandmother used to take him to
questions.hint: "a small, slightly old-fashioned place... my grandmother used to take me to every Saturday."

questions.text: What is on the walls of Daniyar's café?
opts: Old photographs which show Aktobe in the 1970s and 80s
questions.correct: Old photographs which show Aktobe in the 1970s and 80s
questions.hint: "The walls are covered in old photographs which show Aktobe in the 1970s and 80s."

questions.text: Daniyar says the café menu hasn't changed since the ___ .
questions.hint: "The menu, which hasn't changed since the 1990s, still has the same soup."

questions.text: What style is Kamila's Almaty library?
questions.hint: "a large, beautiful building that was built in the Soviet era."

questions.text: What does the library connect Kamila to?
questions.hint: "It's become a place that connects me to who I was at sixteen."

questions.text: Kamila visits the library occasionally when in Almaty.
questions.hint: "Every time I'm in Almaty. I sit in the same reading room..." — she does visit regularly.

questions.text: "She's a person ___ always pays attention." Choose the pronoun.
questions.hint: "who" = people. "A person WHO always pays attention." ✅

questions.text: "A book ___ changed my life." Choose the pronoun.
questions.hint: "which" = things. "A book WHICH changed my life." ✅ (or "that")

questions.text: "A place ___ you always feel recognised." Choose.
questions.hint: "where" = places. "A place WHERE you always feel recognised." ✅

questions.text: "The library, ___ was built in 1960, is beautiful." (extra info)
questions.hint: Non-defining (commas) → must use "WHICH", never "that". ✅

questions.text: "A librarian ___ notes I found." (possession)
questions.hint: "WHOSE notes" = possession. "A librarian WHOSE notes I found." ✅

questions.text: "a beautiful small old café" — this order is:
questions.hint: Opinion (beautiful) → Size (small) → Age (old). Correct! ✅

questions.text: "a wooden old beautiful box" — correct order would be:
questions.hint: ✅ Opinion (beautiful) → Age (old) → Material (wooden) → noun (box).

questions.text: "a ___ ring" — correct order: (Kazakh / golden / small)
questions.hint: Size (small) → Colour (golden) → Origin (Kazakh). "a SMALL GOLDEN KAZAKH ring." ✅

questions.text: "She annotated the books." "Annotate" means:
opts: Add notes or comments to a text
questions.correct: Add notes or comments to a text
questions.hint: "annotate" = to write notes or comments in or next to a text.

questions.text: "She read with no deference to authority." This means:
opts: She did not submit to experts' opinions — she questioned them
questions.correct: She did not submit to experts' opinions — she questioned them
questions.hint: "deference to authority" = respectful submission. "No deference" = she questioned them.

questions.text: The bank of the river is ___ with uncontrolled plants.
questions.hint: "overgrown" = covered with plants that have grown without control or maintenance.

questions.text: "A place that gives you perspective." "Perspective" means:
opts: A wider view of things; a way of seeing the bigger picture
questions.correct: A wider view of things; a way of seeing the bigger picture
questions.hint: "perspective" = a particular way of thinking that allows you to see things in proportion.

questions.text: "The discussion that followed was animated." "Animated" means:
questions.hint: "animated" = lively, active, energetic. An animated discussion = a very engaged debate.
